motion.name: frame-pull
motion.purpose: The frame counter pulls up when the current reel changes. Reduced motion skips it.

components.name: Reel band
components.description: An outlined reel on the opening gate.
components.css: .ds-reel-band { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 11rem 1fr auto; gap: 1rem 1.5rem; align-items: end; padding: 1.15rem 1rem 1.2rem; border-top: 1px solid var(--ink); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--ink); background: var(--stock); color: var(--paper); text-decoration: none; font-family: "Big Shoulders Display", "Arial Narrow", sans-serif; } .ds-reel-band strong { font-weight: 800; font-size: 3.25rem; letter-spacing: -0.02em; line-height: 0.85; } .ds-reel-band span { font-family: Literata, "Iowan Old Style", serif; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 400; color: var(--quiet); letter-spacing: 0; } .ds-reel-band .ds-num { font-family: "Martian Mono", ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.85rem; color: var(--edge); } .ds-reel-band:hover, .ds-reel-band:focus-visible { background: var(--ink); color: var(--paper); outline: 2px solid var(--edge); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-reel-band:hover span, .ds-reel-band:focus-visible span { color: var(--paper); }

components.name: Threaded reel
components.description: The reel already inked cobalt. This is the primary action.
components.css: .ds-reel-threaded { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 11rem 1fr auto; gap: 1rem 1.5rem; align-items: end; padding: 1.15rem 1rem 1.2rem; background: var(--ink); color: var(--paper); text-decoration: none; font-family: "Big Shoulders Display", "Arial Narrow", sans-serif; } .ds-reel-threaded strong { font-weight: 800; font-size: 3.25rem; letter-spacing: -0.02em; line-height: 0.85; } .ds-reel-threaded span { font-family: Literata, "Iowan Old Style", serif; font-size: 1rem; color: var(--paper); } .ds-reel-threaded .ds-num { font-family: "Martian Mono", ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.85rem; color: var(--paper); } .ds-reel-threaded:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--edge); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Sprocket
components.description: Frame index. The current hole is filled.
components.css: .ds-sprocket { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 0.45rem; color: var(--quiet); text-decoration: none; font-family: "Big Shoulders Display", "Arial Narrow", sans-serif; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; font-size: 0.8125rem; } .ds-hole { width: 1.15rem; height: 1.65rem; border: 2px solid var(--edge); border-radius: 0.28rem; } .ds-sprocket.is-current { color: var(--paper); } .ds-sprocket.is-current .ds-hole { background: var(--ink); border-color: var(--ink); } .ds-num { font-family: "Martian Mono", ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.75rem; letter-spacing: 0; color: var(--edge); font-weight: 500; } .ds-sprocket:hover { color: var(--paper); } .ds-sprocket:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--edge); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Work plate
components.description: A title, an italic credit, and the essay on stock.
components.html:
Invisible Cities

Italo Calvino, 1972

Marco Polo sits with Kublai Khan and describes cities the Khan will never visit.
components.css: .ds-work { padding: 2.75rem 0 3rem; border-top: 1px solid var(--ink-deep); color: var(--body); font-family: Literata, "Iowan Old Style", serif; font-size: 1.125rem; line-height: 1.6; max-width: 68ch; } .ds-work h3 { margin: 0 0 0.7rem; font-family: "Big Shoulders Display", "Arial Narrow", sans-serif; font-weight: 800; font-size: 3.4rem; letter-spacing: -0.02em; line-height: 0.9; color: var(--paper); } .ds-credit { margin: 0 0 1.25rem; font-style: italic; color: var(--edge); } .ds-work p { margin: 0; }

components.name: Cobalt plate
components.description: The middle work of a chapter, set on a full cobalt field.
components.html:
The Left Hand of Darkness

Ursula K. Le Guin, 1969

Genly Ai crosses the Gobrin ice with Estraven.
components.css: .ds-plate { padding: 3.5rem 6vw; background: var(--ink); color: var(--paper); font-family: Literata, "Iowan Old Style", serif; } .ds-plate h3 { margin: 0 0 0.7rem; font-family: "Big Shoulders Display", "Arial Narrow", sans-serif; font-weight: 800; font-size: 3.4rem; letter-spacing: -0.02em; line-height: 0.9; color: var(--paper); } .ds-plate .ds-credit { margin: 0 0 1.25rem; font-style: italic; color: #dbe7ff; } .ds-plate p { margin: 0; max-width: 68ch; font-size: 1.2rem; line-height: 1.6; }

components.name: Next reel
components.description: Names the next frame at the end of a chapter.
components.css: .ds-next { display: inline-flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 0.8rem; color: var(--paper); text-decoration: none; font-family: "Big Shoulders Display", "Arial Narrow", sans-serif; font-weight: 800; font-size: 2.6rem; letter-spacing: -0.02em; border-bottom: 2px solid var(--ink); padding-bottom: 0.15rem; } .ds-next span { font-family: "Martian Mono", ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.85rem; letter-spacing: 0; color: var(--edge); font-weight: 500; } .ds-next:hover, .ds-next:focus-visible { color: var(--paper); background: var(--ink); border-bottom-color: var(--ink); padding: 0.2rem 0.55rem 0.25rem; outline: 2px solid var(--edge); outline-offset: 3px; }

narrative.overview:
The shelf is a film bench at night. Black stock is the room. Cobalt is the lab lamp, and it owns whole bands, not thin highlights. A visitor threads one reel and reads. The page is a gate, a sprocket, and essays, in that order.

Density is uneven on purpose. The opening gate is one screen. A chapter is long type. A solid cobalt bar sits between chapters so the strip has a cut, not a hairline. Motion is one pull on the frame counter. Everything else is still.
keyCharacteristics: Black ground, one cobalt, no third hue
Square gates and bands; the only curve is a sprocket hole
Display type for names, a serif for reading, mono only for frame counts
The threaded reel is a filled cobalt band
Frame numbers tell you where you are

rules.name: The One Lamp Rule
rules.body: Cobalt is the only chromatic color. If a passage needs emphasis, it becomes a cobalt field. It does not grow a second accent.

rules.name: The Counter Rule
rules.body: Martian Mono appears only on frame numbers. Credits, notes, and essays stay in Literata.

rules.name: The Strip Rule
rules.body: Chapters are frames on one page, not separate cards. A cobalt void (7.5rem, 4.5rem on a narrow screen) is the cut between reels.

rules.name: The Flat Gate Rule
rules.body: Do not add drop shadows, glows, or blur to make a band feel raised. A filled cobalt rectangle is the raised state.

dos: Do keep the ground on film stock and the emphasis on lab cobalt.
Do use Big Shoulders Display for names and Literata for anything a person reads.
Do mark the current frame in the sprocket and in the live counter.
donts: Don't introduce a third hue, a cream ground, or gray secondary text.
Don't put Martian Mono on credits, body, or labels that are not frame counts.
Don't wrap a work in a rounded card, a glass panel, or a glow.
Don't put an eyebrow label above a heading. The heading is the name.
